description: CI bundle size budgets for the Docusaurus documentation build. Thresholds are based on measured production asset sizes after docs versioning (current + 22.0), with ~12% headroom for intentional growth. Update deliberately when a feature requires a larger budget.
notes: Sizes are uncompressed on-disk bytes after `bun run build` (not gzip transfer size).
Total JS includes all code-split chunks across versioned doc sets; the main entry is checked separately as the critical-path budget.
Budgets were refreshed after the merge campaign + Docusaurus versioning roughly tripled aggregate JS chunk volume versus the 2026-07 single-version baseline.

The older `.performancebudget.json` values (300 KB JS / 50 KB CSS) are aspirational Lighthouse resource targets and are intentionally not used as hard CI gates here because they do not match current output.
